summary: can not see that which we must ponder until we sit and conquer monsters of meaning by squandering our wonder in awakening ones leviathan lines structure in stains of history pooling at edges of a writers cup #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
can not
see that which we
must ponder
until we sit
and conquer
monsters
of
meaning
by squandering
our wonder
in awakening
ones
leviathan lines
structure
in stains
of history pooling
at edges
of a writers
cup
#smallpoems
